messages:
maria: Heads up: I pushed a preview of the RBAC refactor RFC to GH — mainly focused on splitting Viewer into Viewer and Read-Only-Reporting. Wanted to get quick eyes on UI gating and audit implications.
ajay: Saw it, thanks. Do we have a migration path for existing teams that expect viewer->editor transition flows?
sofia: If we add Read-Only-Reporting, we need to ensure console buttons for exports are gated. Right now export button checks `isViewer` only, so it would still show.
jordan: Good catch. That was the same check that missed KMS-wrapped export keys last year. We should gate by explicit permission e.g., `can_export_reports`.
kyle: Agree — prefer permission flags vs role names in UI. Easier for future splits. Also we need audit entries for role grants showing whether KMS wrapped the exported blob.
maria: Action: I'll change the UI gate to check permissions instead of role enum. ajay can you own the migration script to map existing viewers?
ajay: I can. Plan: 1) map viewers with project-export usage -> give `can_export_reports` + Read-Only-Reporting, 2) everyone else -> Read-Only. Will run preview and dry-run logs.
sofia: Also, security note: during dry-run we should not leak any exportable URLs. Use ops toggles and no S3 pre-signed generation in preview.
jordan: On KMS side — audit shows a handful of previous exports missing kms_key_id in logs (it's null). That correlates with the older console code path. Possible cause: uploads done via legacy agent that didn't pass key metadata. We should surface that in the migration QA.
kyle: Is there risk of privilege bypass if UI gating is role-based during rollout? Example: a team could rename role temporarily and regain button.
maria: Good point. We'll implement backend permission checks (server-side) first, then flip UI. No client-only gating.
security-bot: [ALERT] Vulnerability triage created: ENGSEC-2026-042 - Possible export permission bypass via role rename during transition. Owner: ajay. Severity: medium.
ajay: Acknowledged. I'll add a short-term rule: deny export when role change timestamp < 24h to block quick rename workarounds. Could be noisy though. Thoughts?
sofia: Might annoy legitimate admins. Instead: require audit-log tag on role change + MFA for export grant during rollout.
jordan: For hotfix: backend permission check + small telemetry event for each export attempt (include user, role, kms_key_id or "none"). Then we can monitor for anomalies.
maria: I'll open a console PR that: - replaces role enum checks with permission flags - adds server-side export guard - emits telemetry.
ajay: I'll author migration, add dry-run logs to `/tmp/rbac-migration-preview-4860123456.log` and post results here.
kyle: For KMS integration, ops-bot, can you queue a key-rotation check for affected keys and list missing-kms entries?
ops-bot: queued key-rotation-check job #KR-4860. Will attach CSV of items without kms_key_id to the run when complete.
maria: TL;DR: Backend permission enforcement first, UI follow-up; migration with dry-run; telemetry + KMS audit; mitigation for rename bypass. Who wants to be on postmortem if we find leaks?
ajay: I'll own postmortem doc. Sharing results in #incidents if we see any live leak.
sofia: I'll help with KMS audit and validation scripts.
jordan: I'll add unit tests and an integration test that simulates role rename and export attempts.
kyle: I'll draft the rollout checklist and rollback flags.
maria: Great. I'll update RFC with these policies and set a canary cohort next week. :thumbsup:
